content.title: Mumbai Indians Vs Punjab Kings Match Highlights: Arshdeep, Prabhsimran And Iyer Keep PBKS Unbeaten
content.text: LSG Vs RR LiveIPL 2026 Points TableIPL Orange Cap 2026IPL Purple Cap 2026Follow Us Last Updated:April 17, 2026, 07:13 ISTMI vs PBKS Highlights, IPL 2026: Half-centuries from Prabhsimran Singh and Shreyas Iyer guide Punjab towards target of 196 with 7 wickets and 21 balls to spare.PBKS batter Prabhsimran Singh. (Picture Credit: X/@IPLT20)MI vs PBKS Highlights, Mumbai Indians vs Punjab Kings: Punjab Kings got the better of Mumbai Indians at the Wankhede Stadium on Thursday with a 7-wicket win thanks to half-centuries from Prabhsimran Singh and Shreyas Iyer as the visitors cruised to the target of 196 with 21 deliveries to spare. Priyansh Arya and Prabhsimran Singh opened the chase for Punjab before the former fell to Allah Ghazanfar for 15 runs. Cooper Connolly came in to replace the fallen batter and made 17 runs off 12 deliveries before the Afghani struck again. Skipper Shreyas Iyer steadied the chase alongside Prabhsimran as the duo added a 139-run stand as both batters brought up their fifties. Shreyas fell to Shardul Thakur after having added 66, while Prabhsimran remained unbeaten on 80 alongside Marcus Stoinis, who chipped in with 10 runs, to close out the chase in just 16.3 overs.Apr 17, 2026 07:13 ISTMumbai Indians vs Punjab Kings Highlights: PBKS Gaining New Fans? Shreyas Iyer Thinks SoGiven how Punjab Kings have been performing since last season, captain Shreyas Iyer says he has noticed the crowd at the venues increasing. “Certainly, I’ve seen crowd coming in numbers and the way they’ve been cheering for the last couple of games. I think the fan-following is definitely going high and it’s so good to see people coming in numbers and cheering for us, supporting and showering their love,” he said.Apr 17, 2026 07:12 ISTMumbai Indians vs Punjab Kings Highlights Prabhsimran Credits YuvrajYet another Punjab cricketer has credited the legendary Yuvraj Singh for helping him improve his game. “In the off-season, I worked a lot with Yuvi paaji (Yuvraj Singh). So whenever I talk to him, he says that you have a lot of time, you can play a little longer. So I just had this in mind that if I play till the end, then I can win it,” Prabhsimran, who blasted an unbeaten 80 told the broadcasters.Apr 17, 2026 07:10 ISTMumbai Indians vs Punjab Kings Highlights: Hardik Pandya Warns UnderperformerMumbai Indians captain Hardik Pandya has had enough. Expect MI to make significant changes for their next match after the five-time IPL champions crashed to their fourth defeat in five matches. “To be very honest, I don’t have much to say right now. I think we really need to go back on the drawing board and see where are we lacking. Is it individuals? Is it as a group? Is it as planning? We’ll just figure it out and see what we can do next,” Pandya said after the match.Apr 16, 2026 23:09 ISTMumbai Indians vs Punjab Kings, IPL 2026 Live Score: Punjab beat Mumbai!Punjab Kings defeated Mumbai Indians by 7 wickets at the Wankhede Stadium, chasing 196 with 21 balls to spare thanks to half-centuries from Prabhsimran Singh and Shreyas Iyer. Quinton de Kock’s 60-ball 112 powered MI to 195/6. He attacked in the powerplay despite two early wickets and put on a 122-run stand with Naman Dhir for the third wicket, targeting Yuzvendra Chahal. PBKS used Shashank Singh’s medium pace in an attempt to break the partnership, but de Kock continued fluently and reached his century in 53 balls. In the death overs, PBKS’ tight bowling kept Hardik Pandya and Sherfane Rutherford in check, with de Kock mostly stranded at the non-striker’s end, limiting MI to 195. Priyansh Arya and Prabhsimran opened for Punjab. Arya scored 15 before falling to Allah Ghazanfar, who also dismissed Cooper Connolly for 17 off 12. Skipper Shreyas Iyer then joined Prabhsimran, and the pair added a 139-run partnership, both reaching fifties. Shreyas made 66 before being dismissed by Shardul Thakur, while Prabhsimran remained unbeaten on 80, supported by Marcus Stoinis’ 10*, as PBKS finished the chase in 16.3 overs.
